comment: DRAFT for the owner and architect to confirm. Allow-list of hosts that library data/library/*.json may cite, with licence, attribution text and stored-text policy. storedText: link-only = cite the URL, never store the host's text; attribution-required = text may be stored with the attribution shown. Sources: docs/roadmap/research/notes-R5-ip-commercial.md section 3 and docs/compliance/blizzard-checklist.md rules 5 and 6. Licence fields marked 'not reviewed' were not read; treat them as all rights reserved. knownViolations lists what the data does today, with a reason each; it may only shrink (tests/unit/library-sources.test.mjs). Do not add a host to hosts or raise a count to silence the test.
